description: List members of a Wikipedia category (articles, subcategories, or files). Supports any language edition and accepts either a category name or full category URL.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category name without the 'Category:' prefix (e.g. '{category}') or the full category URL (e.g. 'https://{lang}.wikipedia.org/wiki/Category:{category}').

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Member type to return: page (articles), subcat (subcategories), file (files), or all. Default: page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of members to return (1-500). Default: 20.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: MediaWiki language edition code (e.g. 'zh', 'en', 'ja'). Default: zh.
